position.en: right half of the <console>, right of <focus_space>

description.zh: <console> 上放置 <module> 的区域，有固定的 22 个槽位。<upgradable_module>可升级，<module_sleep>和<feature_module>固定不变。
description.en: The area on the <console> where <module>s are placed, with 22 fixed slots. Main modules can be upgraded; sleep and feature modules are fixed.

description.zh: <console> 右半边放置 <activation_die> 的区域，位于 <module_area> 下方、<feature_space> 上方。分为 6 格，分别对应骰子点数 1 至 6——每颗<activation_die>掷出后放在与点数匹配的格上。<activate_module>时从此区取用<activation_die>；<reset>的 B 步回收所有已使用的<activation_die>重掷并放回。控制台外另有 <fate_dice_area> 和 <planning_marker> 的放置位。
description.en: The area on the right half of the <console> for <activation_die>s, located below the <module_area> and above the <feature_space>. Divided into 6 spaces, one per die value 1 through 6 — each rolled activation die is placed on the matching space. Dice are taken from this area to activate modules; Reset step B retrieves all used activation dice, re-rolls them, and returns them here. Outside the console, there are separate spots for the <fate_dice_area> and <planning_marker>.

description.zh: 位于 <console> 旁边（不在面板上），放置玩家的 <fate_die>。<setup>从<ontology::game_box>中拿取 1 个<fate_die>放在此处。<favor_test>时投掷此骰子，根据 <favor_of_ager_track> 当前位置判定是否通过。
description.en: Located beside the <console> (not on the board), holding the player's <fate_die>. During setup, take 1 fate die from the game box and place it here. Roll this die for favor tests; the result is checked against the current position on the <favor_of_ager_track>.

description.zh: <console> 左半边放置 <idea_marker> 的格子。上限 12 个，超过不丢弃但无法继续获得。
description.en: A space on the left half of the <console> for holding <idea_marker>s. Capacity is 12; excess markers cannot be gained but are not discarded.

description.zh: <console> 左半边、<idea_space> 上方的格子，用于放置 <focus_marker>。容量 1 个。
description.en: A space on the left half of the <console>, above <idea_space>, for holding a <focus_marker>. Capacity is 1.

description.zh: <console> 右半边放置 <feature_marker> 的区域，位于 <module_area> 下方、<activation_dice_area> 下方。共 6 格，从左到右分别对应耐力（Stamina）、智慧（Intelligence）、镇定（Calm）、灵巧（Dexterity）、表达（Expression）、观察（Perception）六种特征。
description.en: The area on the right half of the <console> for <feature_marker>s, located below the <module_area> and below the <activation_dice_area>. 6 slots, left to right: Stamina, Intelligence, Calm, Dexterity, Expression, Perception.

description.zh: 印于<console>层级 1 右侧。当层级 1 所有安装位被填满时触发：执行一次<gain_income_chip>。
description.en: Printed to the right of tier 1 on the <console>. Triggers when all installation slots in tier 1 are filled: perform <gain_income_chip> once.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 层级 1 所有安装位被填满
<ontology::condition>.en: All installation slots in tier 1 are filled

description.zh: 印于<console>层级 2 右侧。当层级 2 所有安装位被填满时触发：选择一个未激活的<stage_tile>翻至激活面。
description.en: Printed to the right of tier 2 on the <console>. Triggers when all installation slots in tier 2 are filled: choose an inactive <stage_tile> and flip it to its active face.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 层级 2 所有安装位被填满
<ontology::condition>.en: All installation slots in tier 2 are filled

description.zh: <console> 上用于安装 <research_card>、<income_chip>、<goal_chip>、<attribute_chip> 的大片网格区域。由横向的 <tier>（层级）和纵向的 <column>（列）交叉构成安装位，每个安装位可放置一张研究牌或一枚芯片。最左侧一列被层级 4 和层级 5 的<stage_tile>占据——这两个板块纵向延展，从层级 6 开始挡住该列使其不可用于安装。层级 4 和层级 5 初始未激活，需通过建造第 4 个<settlement>激活。
description.en: The large grid area on the <console> for installing <research_card>s, <income_chip>s, <goal_chip>s, and <attribute_chip>s. Composed of horizontal <tier>s and vertical <column>s intersecting to form installation slots — each slot holds one research card or one chip. The leftmost column is occupied by the Stage-4 and Stage-5 tiles, which extend vertically and block that column for installation from tier 6 onward. Stages 4 and 5 start inactive and are unlocked by building the 4th settlement.

description.zh: <console> 层级分区中的一行安装位。从下往上编号，层级 1（最底部）有 4 个 <column> 可用，层级 2 有 6 个，层级 3 有 8 个，层级 4 及以上每层均有 9 个可用。一层的高度等于 <research_card> 长度的三分之一（安装后仅露出上部能力区），也等于 <income_chip> 或 <attribute_chip> 的短边长，或 <goal_chip> 的边长。层级向上无限延伸，但<research_card>和芯片只能安装在已有的空闲安装位上——每个 <column> 内必须从低层级往高层级连续安装，不可跳过空位。层级 6 及以上，最左侧一列因被层级 4/5 的<stage_tile>挡住不可用。
description.en: A horizontal row of installation slots in the <console> tier grid. Numbered bottom-up: tier 1 (lowest) has 4 usable <column>s, tier 2 has 6, tier 3 has 8, and tier 4 and above each have 9 usable slots. One tier's height equals one-third of a <research_card>'s length (when installed, only the top ability section is exposed), and also equals the short edge of an <income_chip> or <attribute_chip>, or the edge length of a <goal_chip>. Tiers extend infinitely upward, but research cards and chips can only be installed in existing empty slots — within each <column>, installation must proceed from lower tiers upward without skipping. At tier 6 and above, the leftmost column is blocked by Stage-4/Stage-5 tiles.

description.zh: <console> 层级分区中的一列安装位，从底部贯穿至顶部。一列的宽度等于一张 <research_card> 的宽度，或一枚 <income_chip>、一枚 <attribute_chip>、两枚 <goal_chip> 的宽度。层级分区共有 10 个纵向列位，其中最左侧一列被层级 4 和层级 5 的<stage_tile>占据（不可用于安装<research_card>或芯片），其余 9 列供<research_card>和芯片安装。<goal_chip> 安装在最左侧可用列，<attribute_chip> 安装在目标列旁，<income_chip> 可安装在任意列。<research_card> 必须与该列此前安装的<research_card>同色（同一研究领域）。每列内的安装必须从低层级开始连续向上，不可跳空。
description.en: A vertical column of installation slots in the <console> tier grid, running from bottom to top. One column's width equals the width of one <research_card>, or one <income_chip>, one <attribute_chip>, or two <goal_chip>s. The tier grid has 10 column positions total; the leftmost is occupied by Stage-4 and Stage-5 tiles (unavailable for cards or chips), leaving 9 columns for cards and chips. <goal_chip>s are installed in the leftmost available column, <attribute_chip>s next to the goal column, and <income_chip>s in any column. <research_card>s in a column must share the same color (research domain). Each column must be filled from lower tiers upward without gaps.

description.zh: <console> 上存放<stored_material>的<ontology::player_holding>。按 3 行 × 6 列排列，共 18 格，每列对应一种<territory>类型，每行对应稀有度（行 1 基础、行 2 稀有、行 3 珍贵）。同一格同类材料堆叠放置。行 1 与行 2 之间每列印有 1 颗钻石，行 2 与行 3 之间每列印有 2 颗钻石——<score_prosperity>时，上下两格均非空则该列对应钻石计为活跃。
description.en: A <ontology::player_holding> on the <console> for <stored_material>s. Arranged in 3 rows × 6 columns = 18 spaces; each column maps to one territory type, each row to a rarity tier (row 1 basic, row 2 rare, row 3 precious). Same-type materials stack in one space. 1 diamond is printed between rows 1-2 per column, 2 diamonds between rows 2-3 per column — during Prosperity scoring, a column's diamonds count as active if both adjacent spaces are non-empty.

description.zh: 行 1 与行 2 之间：每列 1 颗钻石。行 2 与行 3 之间：每列 2 颗钻石。上下相邻两格均非空时该列钻石激活。
description.en: Between rows 1-2: 1 diamond per column. Between rows 2-3: 2 diamonds per column. A column's diamonds activate when both adjacent spaces are non-empty.

description.zh: <console> 左上方用于存放 <goal_chip> 的 <ontology::player_holding>。共 3 格，每格可堆叠任意数量。
description.en: A <ontology::player_holding> on the top-left of the <console> for holding <goal_chip>s. 3 slots, each holding an unlimited stack.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 此格最后一枚 <goal_chip> 被安装后
<ontology::condition>.en: After the last <goal_chip> in this slot is installed

description.zh: <console> 的<module_area>底部的<ontology::player_zone>，共 15 格，一一对应 15 个<upgradable_module>。每格可放置对应<module>的<ontology::tile>，并带一个<ontology::continuous_effect>——condition 为对应<module>升至 3 级时激活其 L3 效果。与<goal_area>类似：格状态变化触发效果。
description.en: A <ontology::player_zone> at the bottom of module slots on the <console>, with 15 slots, one per main module. Each slot can hold the corresponding <ontology::tile> and carries a <ontology::continuous_effect> — when the corresponding module reaches level 3, its L3 effect is activated. Similar to <goal_area>: slot state change triggers the effect.

<ontology::instant_content>.zh: 激活该模组的 L3 效果

description.zh: <console> 上放置<farm>的<ontology::player_holding>，共 3 格，每格初始放置 1 个<farm>。<build_farm>时拿取，不补充。
description.en: A <ontology::player_holding> on the <console> for <farm>s, with 3 slots, each initially holding 1 <farm>. Taken when building; not replenished.

description.zh: <console> 上放置<boat>的<ontology::player_holding>，共 2 格，每格初始放置 1 个<boat>。<build_boat>时拿取，不补充。
description.en: A <ontology::player_holding> on the <console> for <boat>s, with 2 slots, each initially holding 1 <boat>. Taken when building; not replenished.

description.zh: <console> 上放置<settlement>的<ontology::player_holding>，共 4 格，每格初始放置 1 个<settlement>。<build_settlement>时拿取对应格的<settlement>放至<continent>的<building_site>，不补充。每格下方印有钻石——<settlement>被移走后露出，数量因格而异（1、2 或 3 颗）。
description.en: A <ontology::player_holding> on the <console> for <settlement>s, with 4 slots, each initially holding 1 <settlement>. When building, take the <settlement> from its slot and place it on a Building ground on the <continent>; not replenished. Diamonds are printed under each slot — revealed when the <settlement> is removed, in varying numbers per slot (1, 2, or 3).

material.zh: 1 木头 + 1 石头 + 1 黏土
1 沙子 + 1 铁矿 + 1 黏土

<ontology::condition>.zh: 事件阶段 Prosperity（繁荣）计分时
<ontology::condition>.en: During Prosperity scoring in the Event phase

<ontology::instant_content>.zh: 露出的钻石计入活跃钻石总数，乘以 Prosperity 分类倍率获得分数。
<ontology::instant_content>.en: Visible diamonds count toward active diamond total; multiplied by Prosperity category multiplier for points.

description.zh: <console> 上用于安装 <goal_chip> 的列。<goal_chip> 宽度为 <column> 的一半，同一 <tier> 左右半侧各可装一枚。每完成一叠目标芯片可<upgrade_main_module>。
description.en: The column on the <console> for installing <goal_chip>s. <goal_chip>s are half the column width; each <tier> fits one per side (left and right). Completing a stack of goal chips allows upgrading one main module.

description.zh: <console> 上用于安装 <attribute_chip> 的列。<attribute_chip>一旦安装即提供持续效果。
description.en: The column on the <console> for installing <attribute_chip>s. Installed attribute chips provide continuous effects.

description.zh: <console> 上用于安装 <income_chip> 的区域。<phase_8_income>时玩家对每个已安装 <income_chip> 各激活一次，激活顺序由玩家自定。
description.en: The area on the <console> for installing <income_chip>s. During the Income phase, each installed <income_chip> is activated once, in an order of the player's choice.

description.zh: <console> 上存放食物标记的格子，位于<console>左侧、<goal_area> 右边，<money_space> 上方。<hunt>、<income_chip>和某些效果可获得食物标记。<phase_6_feeding>从此格支付食物。食物标记按每 3 个一列排列，每完整列在<score_prosperity>时算 1 个活跃钻石。
description.en: A space on the <console> for holding food markers, located on the left half of the console, to the right of <goal_area>, above <money_space>. Food markers are gained through hunting, income chips, and certain effects. Food is paid from this space during the Feeding phase. Food markers are arranged in columns of 3; each complete column counts as 1 active diamond for Prosperity scoring.

description.zh: <console> 上存放钱币标记的格子，位于<console>左侧、<goal_area> 右边，<food_space> 下方。通过<trade>出售<stored_material>获得。钱币标记按每 2 个一列排列，每完整列在<score_prosperity>时算 1 个活跃钻石。
description.en: A space on the <console> for holding money markers, located on the left half of the console, to the right of <goal_area>, below <food_space>. Money is gained by selling materials via the Trade module. Money markers are arranged in columns of 2; each complete column counts as 1 active diamond for Prosperity scoring.

description.zh: <console> 右半边的 4 列重置轨道，位于 <focus_space> 右侧。每列顶部初始放置 1 个 <reset_marker>。执行 <reset> 时，将最靠左的标记沿列逐步下推——A→B→C 三步，C 步完成后标记离开重置列进入 <idea_space> 或 <food_space>。重置列为空的数量标志着<phase_indicator>已被推进的次数。<phase_8_income>结束时，空列从<ontology::supply>重新补满 <reset_marker>。
description.en: 4 reset columns on the right half of the <console>, to the right of <focus_space>. Each column starts with 1 <reset_marker> at the top. When performing <reset>, the leftmost marker is pushed down its column step by step — A→B→C, after which the marker leaves the column for <idea_space> or <food_space>. The number of empty columns tracks how many times the <phase_indicator> has been advanced. At the end of the Income phase, empty columns are refilled with <reset_marker>s from supply.

position.en: left of reset columns

description.zh: A: 推动阶段标记至下一个 reset space（到达红色格触发行动阶段结束）。B: 回收所有已使用的<activation_die>重掷并放回。C: 重置标记移至创意格或食物格。
description.en: A: Advance phase indicator to next reset space (red space triggers Action Phase end). B: Retrieve all used activation dice, re-roll and return. C: Move reset marker to idea space or food space.

description.zh: 放置在 <reset_column> 中的标记。每位玩家初始有 4 个，<setup>时放在 4 个<reset_column>顶部。执行<reset>时沿列步进，完成 C 步后移入<idea_space>或<food_space>。<phase_8_income>结束时，所有空的<reset_column>重新从<ontology::supply>补满。注意：重置标记不能从<console>召回以补充<ontology::supply>上限（与其他标记不同）。
description.en: A marker placed in a <reset_column>. Each player starts with 4, placed at the top of the 4 reset columns during Setup. Steps down the column during a Reset; after step C, moves to the idea space or food space. At the end of the Income phase, all empty reset columns are refilled from supply. Note: reset markers cannot be recalled from the <console> to replenish the supply limit (unlike other markers).

appearance.zh: 由玩家颜色的八角柱标记（<octagonal_pillar>）表示——放在重置列（<reset_column>）顶部。
appearance.en: Represented by an octagonal marker (<octagonal_pillar>) in the player's color — placed at the top of a reset column (<reset_column>).

description.zh: <public_board>旁用于摆放 10 个<research_card>堆的区域，由 5 个 <research_deck>（背面朝下牌堆）和 5 个 <face_up_research_stack>（正面朝上牌堆）组成。每时代<phase_1_new_cards>从每个<research_deck>顶翻一张到对应的<face_up_research_stack>（第一时代新建堆，后续时代覆盖）。玩家可通过<gain_research_card>从正面或背面牌堆顶拿取卡牌。当<face_up_research_stack>被拿空时，立即从对应<research_deck>翻一张补充。
description.en: The area beside the game boards for the 10 research stacks: 5 <research_deck>s (face-down) and 5 <face_up_research_stack>s (face-up). Each era in Phase 1, reveal the top card from each face-down stack onto the corresponding face-up stack (forming a new stack in era 1, covering the previous card thereafter). Players can take the top card from either stack type via the Research module. When a face-up stack empties, immediately reveal the top card from the corresponding face-down stack.

description.zh: 每种<research_card>类型各有一个的正面朝上牌堆，展示该类型当前可被直接拿取的 <research_card>。与对应的 <research_deck> 配对——当此堆被拿空时，立即从对应<research_deck>翻一张补充。
description.en: One per research card type, a face-up stack showing the currently available <research_card> of that type. Paired with the corresponding <research_deck> — when this stack empties, immediately reveal the top card from the face-down stack.

description.zh: <sequence_board> 上用于放置 <event_card> 的 <ontology::zone>，分左右两格：右边一格放置背面朝上的<event_card>堆，供每时代抽取；左边一格放置正面朝上的<event_card>堆，其中最上面的 <event_card> 的效果将于当前时代的<phase_7_event>被触发。
description.en: A <ontology::zone> on the <sequence_board> for <event_card>s, split into two slots: the right slot holds a face-down event card stack for drawing each era; the left slot holds a face-up event card stack, whose topmost <event_card>'s effect is triggered during this era's Event phase.

description.zh: 此区域存放 <event_card>：右格背面朝上堆叠，左格正面朝上展示当前时代那张。
description.en: This zone holds <event_card>s: the right slot stacked face down, the left slot showing the current era's card face up.

objects.<ontology::information_visibility>: 左边一格为public，右边一格为hidden

description.zh: 5 个背面朝下的<research_card>堆，按卡牌类型区分（建造/洞悉/突变/成就/发明），每堆 32 张。<setup>时分别洗混，与 5 个 <face_up_research_stack> 一一配对。每时代<phase_1_new_cards>翻一张到对应正面堆；被拿空后继续从背面翻。
description.en: 5 face-down research stacks, one per card type (Building/Insight/Mutation/Achievement/Invention), 32 cards each. Shuffled separately during setup. Each is paired with a <face_up_research_stack>. Phase 1 reveals the top card to the face-up stack each era; when the face-up stack empties, reveal the next card from here.

description.zh: 放置 <starting_marker_card> 的牌堆。<setup>后不再使用。
description.en: The deck holding <starting_marker_card>s. Not used after setup.

description.zh: 放置 <starting_chip_card> 的牌堆。<setup>后作为第一个<income_chip>塞入<console>。
description.en: The deck holding <starting_chip_card>s. After setup, it becomes the first income chip slid under the <console>.

description.zh: 《文明演化》纸质规则书，用于查询详细规则。
description.en: The printed rulebook for Civolution, used for detailed rule lookups.

appearance.zh: 纸质规则手册。
appearance.en: A printed rulebook.

description.zh: 帮助玩家理解<phase_sequence>和图标含义的辅助卡。
description.en: A card helping players understand phase order and icon meanings.

appearance.zh: 每位玩家一份的小册子（共 4 份），汇总游戏图标与要素含义。
appearance.en: A booklet (4 in total, one per player) summarizing game icons and elements.

description.zh: 一种可由玩家主动执行的动作型 <ontology::effect>：平时不激活（不是被动或持续效果），只有当玩家执行 <perform_activity>（选择 1 个可用的活动并激活）时，才作为候选被选中执行。实例填写 cost / target / content。
description.en: An action-type <ontology::effect> a player can actively perform: not active by itself (not a passive or persistent effect); it only executes when chosen as the candidate of <perform_activity> (choose 1 available activity and activate it). Instances fill cost / target / content.

description.zh: Civolution 玩家保留区通用引用，主要指玩家手牌中的研究牌。
description.en: Generic player holding reference in Civolution, mainly referring to research cards in hand.
